wholePhysicalScope: Three native map ways define the current restaurant, carhop cover and parking structure. The restaurant anchor and sight lines are aligned with North Avenue. Footings and garage access follow the original USGS bare-earth raster.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the folded marquee, rounded entry, roadside V and open carhop shelter.
limitations: The standing North Avenue location is modeled. The parking deck section, roof plant, sign lettering, colors, light levels and curving glazing are simplified.
The west roadside sign stands at an approximate position derived from the night street view and operator record. Third-party advertising, interiors, cars and landscaping are outside scope.
